scientific_integrity: The theorem is supported by its explicit unrestricted proof, not by numerical enumeration alone. The 1983-07-01 date is verified by the original publisher; the contents of an earlier 1982 preprint were not inspected.
scientific_limitations: Only simultaneous binary Rule 250 with cyclic boundaries of size at least three.
Classical bounded-gap enumeration is used; no new general inclusion-exclusion theorem is asserted.
Absolute historical priority and independent mathematical validation remain open.
title: Exact transient-depth census for cyclic Rule 250
